name: Masala Vegetable Idli
ingredients: ½ cup finely chopped mixed vegetables
steps: Cut idlis into quarters; if freshly steamed, cool them first so they hold their shape.
Heat oil in a wide pan. Add mustard seeds, urad dal and curry leaves.
Add vegetables, turmeric and a splash of water. Cover and cook 3–4 minutes until just tender.
Add idli pieces and sambar powder. Toss gently over low heat until hot throughout.
Finish with coriander and lemon. Serve with sambar for extra protein and fibre.
note: Use fermented, egg-free idlis. For a higher-protein plate, serve with a generous bowl of lentil-rich sambar.
